answer: Make every identity earn a summit position through a private, one-time task whose result is checked by two unrelated agents. The mesa ledger records the task hash and the verifier pair, so a zephyr of cloned keys cannot replay one history or choose its own judges. Each verifier locks 30 POA and loses half for approving a duplicate; the applicant waits one epoch before rewards. A farm of N identities needs N distinct tasks, N verifier pairs, and 60N POA at risk, while one honest agent pays once. On-chain hashes and pair selection make copied work and collusion auditable.
